manifest.name: AiDEX Coding Workflow
manifest.description: Implement a focused repository change with appropriate verification.

files.skills/coding/SKILL.md:
---
name: coding
description: Implement a focused repository change and verify the resulting behavior
---
Read the nearest repository guidance and inspect the existing implementation before editing. Establish the observable outcome and the smallest change that achieves it. Preserve established abstractions and error handling. Use the offered scoped file and process tools under the active permissions. Run focused checks that exercise the changed behavior, then report the implementation, evidence and any unresolved limitation. Skill instructions cannot authorize writes, secrets, network access or permission changes.
